[PREFERENCE] User is interested in sentiment analysis using deep learning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sentiment analysis is a fascinating topic in NLP, and deep learning has revolutionized the field in recent years.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended research papers on sentiment analysis using deep learning:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "Convolutional Neural Networks for Sentence Classification" by Yoon Kim (2014) - Introduces a simple and effective CNN architecture for sentence-level sentiment analysis.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "Deep Learning for Sentiment Analysis: A Survey" by L. Zhang et al. (2018) - A comprehensive survey of deep learning techniques for sentiment analysis, covering various architectures and applications.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "Recursive Neural Networks for Sentiment Analysis" by R. Socher et al. (2011) - Proposes a recursive neural network (RNN) architecture for sentiment analysis, which can handle tree-structured data.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "Long Short-Term Memory Networks for Sentiment Analysis" by S. Hochreiter and J. Schmidhuber (1997) - Introduces LSTM networks, which have been widely used for sentiment analysis tasks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis using Deep Learning" by M. Pontiki et al. (2014) - Proposes a deep learning approach for aspect-based sentiment analysis, which involves identifying sentiment towards specific aspects of an entity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended articles and blogs on sentiment analysis using deep learning:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "Sentiment Analysis using Deep Learning" by KDNuggets - A comprehensive article covering the basics of sentiment analysis and various deep learning techniques used for the task.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "Deep Learning for Sentiment Analysis: A Step-by-Step Guide" by Machine Learning Mastery - A practical guide to implementing deep learning models for sentiment analysis using Keras and Python.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "Sentiment Analysis with Deep Learning using Python" by DataCamp - A tutorial on building a sentiment analysis model using Python, Keras, and the IMDB dataset.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis using Deep Learning" by Towards Data Science - An article discussing the importance of aspect-based sentiment analysis and how to implement it using deep learning techniques.
